latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of academic-search skill.

- Enables systematic academic paper search across arXiv, Google Scholar, and Semantic Scholar.
- Filters and summarizes the Top 5 most relevant papers, with full bibliographic metadata and key findings.
- Analyzes citation networks to highlight seminal and trending works.
- Clearly distinguishes preprints from peer-reviewed papers, noting access status and venue.
- Enforces strict relevance, quality, and authenticity constraints for returned results.
